supersedes: v1 assigned the complete prior-close/end move to current decision phase; v2 assigns close/open price gaps to previous live phase and RTH/fills/fees to current known phase.
scope: Known-at-execution risk state partitions actual interval equity deltas/log growth. MAX_DD is each existing account hindsight descriptive window, not a trading rule. Every interval first marks previous cash/quantity to current Open; this CLOSE_TO_OPEN leg uses the previous activated phase, so a new first-RTH acceptance cannot claim the already-realized overnight gap. OPEN_TO_END uses current decision phase and includes actual fills/fees. INITIAL/ACCEPTED include transitions. Dollar/log amounts describe the existing cash path, not avoidable loss, standalone component alpha, counterfactual strategy performance, or independent samples.
